Do not omit any of these". run 0 raw emits played-col, better-col, you-key-square, you-key-line — opp-key-square missing, so the opponent's completing square c7r3 is never highlighted. run 1 raw emits better-col, you-key-line, played-col, opp-key-square — you-key-square missing, so your own completing square c5r4 is never highlighted. 2/3 runs drop exactly one required handle.

run 2 served: "...porque esa casilla que importa más adelante termina quedando del lado gris cuando la línea forzada se agota." The zone is future:c7r3. Replaying opponentPunishment.finalMovestring 333331111551530000001244442222244565566 puts player 1 (verde) on c7r3 at ply 39, completing the four c4r3-c5r3-c6r3-c7r3; the prompt's own projectedDeepOpp board prints r3 as "O Y Y O O O O" (c7r3 = O = opponent). The served text hands the player the exact opposite of the mechanism.
